sources.title: Explore Azure Service Bus concepts and messaging in AI architectures
sources.contentRelevance: Broker queues absorb bursts and decouple request intake from processing. Standard and Premium have different capacity models. Queue allocation is not exactly-once processing; reliability claims use the separate receive-mode unit.

parents.evidenceSummary: The actual sb-module retrieval directly links https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/queue-process-operations-service-bus/2-explore-service-bus-concepts; the separate sb-concepts MCP retrieval returned this article title and substantive body. Evidence: raw\sb-module.json and raw\sb-module-html-receipt.json; raw\sb-concepts.json.
parents.relevanceJustification: Broker queues absorb bursts and decouple request intake from processing. Standard and Premium have different capacity models. Queue allocation is not exactly-once processing; reliability claims use the separate receive-mode unit.

sources.title: Process messages reliably
sources.contentRelevance: PeekLock and receive-and-delete trade settlement reliability for overhead. Complete, abandon, defer and dead-letter serve distinct outcomes. Delivery limits, explicit DLQ resubmission and lock renewal are documented; renewal does not guarantee exactly-once effects.

parents.evidenceSummary: The actual sb-module retrieval directly links https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/modules/queue-process-operations-service-bus/5-process-messages-reliably; the separate sb-reliability MCP retrieval returned this article title and substantive body. parents.relevanceJustification: PeekLock and receive-and-delete trade settlement reliability for overhead. Complete, abandon, defer and dead-letter serve distinct outcomes. Delivery limits, explicit DLQ resubmission and lock renewal are documented; renewal does not guarantee exactly-once effects.

sources.title: Configure delivery and retry policies for reliable event processing
sources.contentRelevance: Traditional custom-topic webhook delivery uses acknowledgement, endpoint-specific error treatment, time and attempt limits, optional Blob dead-letter storage and all-or-none batches. Selected claims exclude the introductory overgeneralization that every unsuccessful status retries.

sources.title: Set up the local development environment for Functions
sources.contentRelevance: Core Tools hosts local triggers; function_app.py, host.json, requirements.txt and .funcignore have separate roles. Azurite supplies local host storage. Deployment/settings commands must preserve production configuration. The Python reference resolves the unit’s overbroad publish-with-settings wording.

sources.title: Azure Functions developer reference guide for Python apps
sources.contentRelevance: Python v2 route_params reads route segments; blueprints must be registered with the main app. requirements.txt drives remote dependencies, .funcignore excludes deployment files, and changing Python version requires rebuilding and redeploying artifacts. Preview or new worker-version controls are excluded.
